description: Trap-heavy planning chat: ideas, a named person mentioned without a commitment, 'I'll think about it'. Only one real action.
transcript: Let's brainstorm the features for next year.
We should probably support a second microphone at some point.
Maybe we could ask Pedro what he thinks about the battery.
I'll think about the pricing, no promises.
It might be worth trying a bigger language model.
Lucia will write the feature list into the wiki by next Monday.
Let's keep the rest open for now.
